planName: Saved Item Sheet — Live Updates (Edit Mode)

architecturalDecisions.title: Edit-only scope
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live updates apply only when editing an existing saved item. Add mode remains submit-on-button.

architecturalDecisions.title: No edit footer affordance
architecturalDecisions.decision: Edit mode removes the Update button and footer spacing entirely. Add mode keeps existing footer.

architecturalDecisions.title: Unified writer reuse
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live writes call updateSavedItem (unified local/cloud behavior) rather than introducing a new writer split.

architecturalDecisions.title: Local promotion continuity
architecturalDecisions.decision: When a local item is promoted to cloud on first write, in-session edit target state is updated to the promoted cloud record for subsequent writes.

architecturalDecisions.title: Debounce contract
architecturalDecisions.decision: Name is debounced with 300ms trailing delay; category and store are immediate.

architecturalDecisions.title: Close lifecycle split
architecturalDecisions.decision: onStartClose flushes pending debounce; onDismiss performs reset and snapshot cleanup.

architecturalDecisions.title: Validity guard
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live writes skip while name is empty after trim.

architecturalDecisions.title: Keyboard semantics
architecturalDecisions.decision: Edit mode uses ItemSheetProvider mode='update' so return key blurs and does not submit.

architecturalDecisions.title: Error handling
architecturalDecisions.decision: No new error UI is introduced; behavior relies on existing optimistic/offline pipeline.

phases.title: Saved-item edit live updates
userStories: Story 2: dismiss flushes pending text edits
Story 4: empty name does not write
Story 6: return key blurs in edit mode
Story 8: local item promotion continues seamlessly in-session

tickets.title: Add edit live-sync hook for saved items
tickets.summary: Create a saved-item-specific live-sync hook that captures baseline on present, performs debounced name writes and immediate category/store writes via updateSavedItem, flushes on close, and clears on dismiss.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook reads current form state from useItemSheet and tracks latest values through refs
Debounced trailing name write uses 300ms useDebounceCallback
Immediate writes trigger on category/store changes
Writes are skipped when trimmed name is empty
Hook exposes imperative handle: captureSnapshot, flushAndSyncOnClose, clearSnapshot
Hook supports local->cloud promotion by updating active editing target state when updateSavedItem returns promoted id

tickets.title: Wire live-sync into saved-item sheet edit path
tickets.summary: Integrate live-sync hook into SavedItemSheetProvider and SavedItemSheetContents, split add/edit mode behavior, and remove edit-mode footer affordances.
acceptanceCriteria: ItemSheetProvider mode is update in edit mode and add in add mode
Edit onSubmit becomes no-op; add onSubmit remains existing path
BottomSheet onStartClose calls liveSyncRef.flushAndSyncOnClose in edit mode
BottomSheet onDismiss calls reset and liveSyncRef.clearSnapshot in edit mode
Footer button and footer spacing are omitted in edit mode
Add mode footer/button/toast behavior remains unchanged
Edit mode success toast is removed
